title: Quarterly Catalog Release Gating and Customer Feedback Loop for Hosted API
creator: Carlos Rivera
description: Purpose: Define and operationalize a quarterly release gating process for model variants published to the Hosted API model catalog, plus a continuous customer feedback loop that routes qualitative issues back into prioritization. Scope: hosted API model lineups, canary rollout windows, gating signal definitions (latency, perf regressions, hallucination rate by eval set, embedding drift), and the CS/Success intake workflow for urgent customer-reported quality regressions. Out of scope: Dedicated hardware capacity reservations, on-prem packaging changes.
acceptance_criteria: A gating checklist exists that can be executed by PM/Eng before scheduling a model publish window
At least 5 automated signals (latency_p95, token_cost_delta, eval_regression_rate, top_k_semantic-drift, error_rate) are wired to the release dashboard
A documented CS intake path that ties a customer report to a triage ticket and auto-tags model variants and datasets
Canary plan template completed: percentage ramping, rollback trigger thresholds, and fallback-to-previous-variant policy
Playbook with runbook steps for rollback and customer communication is published and reviewed by Support and SRE
tasks: Draft gating checklist and approval flow (PM + Head of Applied ML)
Instrument additional model health signals in Console (Eng + Observability)
Create CS intake form and triage automation (Customer Success + Solutions Eng)
Build canary rollout template in release tooling with percentage ramps and guardrails
Run one dry-run on non-critical hosted model and capture telemetry and manual feedback

risks: Signal noise causing false positives and unnecessary rollbacks
Insufficient sampling in canary leading to missed regressions for niche prompts
CS intake lacks context leading to long repro cycles
Dashboards missing correlation between customer reports and signal spikes
mitigations: Add mandatory minimum sample sizes and smoothing windows for metrics
Include targeted prompt cohort evals as part of canary to stress niche flows
Require CS to attach transcript/uids and provide reproduction steps before escalation
Wire an automatic link from triage ticket to the model rollout and metric snapshot
